title: Live Cell Quantification using Image Analysis
author: Minjung Song, Iman Mali, Venkat Pisupati, Florian T Merkle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bzgep3te
materials: CellMask Deep Red plasma membrane dye

steps.title: Prepare and Plate Cells
steps.instruction: Coat a plate with an appropriate substrate and plate cells, ensuring even distribution.

substeps.instruction: Use a 24-well black μ-Plate from Ibidi for optimal growth and imaging compatibility.
Use a large enough volume of medium (e.g., 500 mL per well of a 24-well plate) to ensure even distribution.
Shake the plate left-to-right and top-to-bottom, avoiding circular motions.
Repeat shaking motions once the plate is transferred to a level incubator shelf; close the incubator gently to avoid vibrations.

steps.title: Stain Plasma Membrane
steps.instruction: Label the plasma membrane once cells reach approximately 80% confluence.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate medium and wash once with DPBS.
Add a standard volume of staining solution (e.g., 500 µL for a well of a 24-well plate) at a 1:1000 dilution (optimized for hPSCs at 80% confluence).
Incubate cells for 00:10:00 at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash and Recover Cells
steps.instruction: Remove excess stain and return cells to culture media.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells two times with DPBS (500 µL per well for a 24-well plate).
Perform three additional washes with DPBS.
Add culture media after the final wash.

steps.title: Prepare Plate for Imaging
steps.instruction: Seal and clean the plate for transport to the imaging facility.

substeps.instruction: Seal wells with sterile B seal film.
Wipe the bottom of the plate with a clean tissue to remove dust, fingerprints, or media.

steps.title: Configure Imaging System
steps.instruction: Set up the automated confocal imaging system (e.g., PerkinElmer Opera Phenix).

substeps.instruction: Define plate parameters and regions to be imaged ahead of time.
Set magnification to 20x (for 24-well plates) and select 10-30 randomly selected fields covering at least 5% of the surface area.

steps.title: Acquire Images
steps.instruction: Image all wells to be quantified at room temperature within 30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: For CellMask Deep Red dye: use a 647 nm laser at ~50% power and an exposure time of ~200 ms.
Capture a stack of 3 optical sections separated by 0.8 microns, starting at the plate surface using a 20x Water objective.

steps.title: Post-Imaging Plate Care
steps.instruction: Clean and return the plate to the incubator.

substeps.instruction: Wipe the plate with 70% ethanol and return it to a biosafety cabinet.
Remove B seal film and return the plate to the incubator.

steps.title: Perform Image Analysis
steps.instruction: Segment cells and quantify using software (e.g., Harmony).

substeps.instruction: Select basic flatfield correction and maximum projection (ensure all z-planes are selected for max projection).
Segment cells using the 'Find nuclei' function (method B and M for hPSCs at 80% confluence), adjusting threshold, size, and splitting sensitivity as needed.
Test parameters on multiple fields and wells during optimization.

steps.title: Calibrate Quantification Results
steps.instruction: Validate the image analysis pipeline by dissociating and quantifying cells using a manual hemocytometer and/or automated cell counter.

description: Remove noise from the background (e.g. with a sliding parabola filter) with settings to be optimised by the user.
